recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast urban group portrait featuring a collective of individuals in 90s streetwear posed around a vehicle, framed by heavy slab-serif typography against a stark white background and a dark footer.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale display type dominating the top third of the composition
A horizontal line of figures creating a central visual band
High-contrast sepia/monochrome photography against flat graphic blocks
Symmetrical balance between the central vehicle and flanking figures
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typeface with thick outlines
Stark white negative space in the upper half
Solid black footer bar for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group is positioned in the lower-middle ground, scaled to span the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure leaning against the car hood acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the heavy top text, drops to the central figure, then scans outward to the flanking group members before landing on the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top provides breathing room for the heavy display type.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Sepia/Burnt Umber (photographic mid-tones and text fill)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square proportions
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs with minimal bracketing
Thick external drop-shadow or offset outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Compressed width to fit multiple words on a single line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Solid black horizontal bar at bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and square proportions.
Classic geometric slab serif with similar terminal construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle, high-contrast sepia photograph of a group of 7 people in 90s urban streetwear (hoodies, bandanas, jackets) posed around a small 90s hatchback car in a gravel lot. The top 40% of the image should be pure white negative space. The bottom 10% should be a solid black horizontal bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, uppercase slab-serif text in the white space at the top using a dark brown fill and black outline. Add smaller, centered, uppercase slab-serif text in white inside the black bar at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the top text heavy and slab-serif?
Is there a clear black bar at the bottom?
Are the figures posed in a horizontal line?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Height of the bottom black bar
postGenerationChecks: Check that the sepia tone is consistent across all figures
Verify the slab serifs are thick and blocky
Confirm the white space at the top is clean and empty of imagery
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [90s urban group photography] + [Sepia duo-tone filter] + [Heavy Slab-Serif Display Type] + [Stark White/Black framing].
